title: No implicit object truthiness; array.slice is exclusive

blocks.text:
You can no longer test an object's nullness simply by saying "if object:",
nor with not like "if not object:". There is no longer any implicit
conversion between these. Use is_instance_valid(object) or an explicit
comparison against null.

The end of array.slice() is no longer inclusive of the final element; it
has been changed to an exclusive ending. Off-by-one bugs after a mechanical
3→4 rename will parse cleanly.
